Profile panels04

Desktop · profile panels
Profile panels · desktopMemories, Skills, Tools and Schedules open as one window: the profile’s mark and name, the four panels as tabs (the count on the open one, a red count on any that needs you), a search row, a list and a reader. Every tab draws one row (a 15 px title, a 14 px second line, one 12 px meta a state word replaces) and one header (a 20 px title, the state as a word, the id in mono with copy), then one facts table. Mono only for ids and code.

Desktop has no settings pageUpdates, notifications, Activity and the theme button live in the one sidebar footer; the default profile’s settings carry the same System / Light / Dark control, and text size is a command in the palette (window zoom). First run09

Desktop · first run
First runBefore drawing the shell the app asks the machine for its own alpi: running, stopped, absent or unsupported. On a true first run, with the local alpi never having answered on this machine and at most one saved connection, the window is the Welcome alone, with no sidebar. In every other case the Sidebar stays and the Welcome fills the main pane beside it. Once alpi has answered in a session, a later outage keeps the open view under the reconnecting banner.
alpi runs hereThe window lands on the roster, alpi first. The connection reads This computer; one Mono line under the composer, with the composer focused, says how to add a phone and goes away with the first message.

    Desktop · tray
    Tray popoverA left click on the menu bar icon opens a small popover that triages. Twin at 40 px wears the state and a one-line summary says what the rows do not: then what needs you with Review, failing jobs as a tinted banner, running turns, and the next scheduled jobs grouped by day, within a five-row budget, over every connected daemon (each row names its connection when there are several), an update ready, and Open alpi, notifications, Settings and Quit in the footer. A right click keeps the native menu.

    Rules
    The popover never calls the daemon and never reads ~/.alpi: the main window pushes one snapshot, already filtered by connection and profile scope. It follows the app theme (System, Light or Dark) and is 340 wide inside a 342 window, with a 1 px inset edge and no drop shadow, which the transparent window would clip.Type: title 20 semibold, summary 14, section labels 14, names 14 in Bricolage 800 toned with nameTone, job 15, meta 12, times 14 tabular in ink-2. Rows are 52 high on the control radius; marks animate only while the popover has focus and never under reduced motion.Esc and losing focus hide it. Open alpi and Review show, unminimize and focus the main window; Review carries the deeplink of an approval or a question. The footer bell is hidden for members.

    Rules
    One ink with binary alpha: the asset is a template the OS tints for the bar, so it reads on a light, a dark and a translucent bar. It is Twin at half its held turn, its eyes cut out, drawn on the pixel grid of each size, and the marks carry a 1 px knock-out.Priority: needs you (ring), then offline (slash), then unread or an update (dot), then quiet. The icon is set once, and only when the state or the size changed.Windows and Linux pick the size from the display scale when the state changes: moving the app between displays of different scale keeps the old size until the next state change.
